crossRefs.note: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God.

translations.web: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him. He shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight.
translations.bsb: He shall be treated like a man hired from year to year, but a foreign owner must not rule over him harshly in your sight.
translations.kjv: And as a yearly hired servant shall he be with him: and the other shall not rule with rigour over him in thy sight.
translations.asv: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him: he shall not rule with rigor over him in thy sight.
